title: Listening Drill — Restoring a cinema
description: Interview. One recording, four questions. Synthetic audio.

sections.title: Restoring a cinema
sections.transcript:
HOST: You work on restoring a small cinema. What got your team started? People often think projects like yours begin with a large grant.

GUEST: Ours started with a volunteer group. At the time our biggest obstacle was roof leaks. We had to change the plan before we could make proper progress.

HOST: What surprised you once you started getting results?

GUEST: We discovered original fittings. It helped us improve interior plans. That wasn't a goal we had written into the original proposal.

HOST: And what happens next?

GUEST: We'll make an inventory of the remaining equipment. Then we'll decide whether to expand.
